steps.why_en: Only ID, position code and dates are received; person name and address are missing.
steps.why_id: Hanya ID, kode jabatan, dan tanggal yang diterima; nama dan alamat orang tidak ada.

steps.en: The notice goes back to the 2nd reminder for the Owner/Partner
steps.id: NOPO dikembalikan ke reminder ke-2 untuk Owner/Partner
steps.why_en: No process returns the notice to the 2nd reminder from company officer data.
steps.why_id: Tidak ada proses yang mengembalikan notice ke reminder ke-2 dari data pengurus company.

steps.en: The Owner/Partner is recorded as the new owner with an address
steps.id: Owner/Partner dicatat sebagai pemilik baru dengan alamat
steps.why_en: Company officers are never written as the new owner and their address is not saved.
steps.why_id: Pengurus company tidak pernah ditulis sebagai pemilik baru dan alamatnya tidak disimpan.

steps.en: The 2nd reminder letter is sent to the Owner/Partner
steps.id: Letter reminder ke-2 dikirim ke Owner/Partner
steps.why_en: A general second-reminder letter exists, but it is not addressed to the officer and printer delivery is blocked in prod.
steps.why_id: Letter reminder ke-2 umum ada, tetapi bukan untuk pengurus dan pengiriman ke pencetak diblok di prod.
